best_for: People and teams who already run a Nextcloud server, or rent one, and want its files synced to their Windows PC or Mac.

points.title: Useless without a server
points.text: The desktop client only syncs with a Nextcloud server. You need your own server, a hosted one, or an account someone gives you.

points.title: Pick what lands on disk
points.text: Choose What to Sync limits which folders download, and virtual files, where your client turns them on, show files that only download when opened.

points.title: Several accounts at once
points.text: You can add more than one Nextcloud account, and each gets its own tab in settings.

points.title: New Windows and Macs only
points.text: The current client needs 64-bit Windows 10 version 1809 or later, or macOS 13 or later. Macs on macOS 11 or 12 can use the legacy 3.13.4 build.

points.title: Linux packages are community work
points.text: Nextcloud publishes an AppImage for Linux. Distribution packages are maintained by the community, and no Linux build is listed on this site.

points.title: Versions kept here
points.text: The Windows installer is x64 and installs machine-wide, and the Windows listing keeps 90 versions. The Mac package is universal, with only the current release listed.
